verdict.rationale: A consent portal where end users view and revoke app access to their bank data is a fair question for a bank-data aggregator, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents such a surface: the docs cover Link (the account-linking flow), developer Dashboard customization and webhooks, none of which is a user-facing revocation portal. The community post asking how to make Plaid lose access is a question, not evidence of the capability.

support.subject: As an ops lead, end users can see and revoke what they've shared — a documented consent surface or portal where a user manages which apps hold access to their bank data
